title: Piggybac-mediated stable expression of NGN2 in iPSCs for differentiation into excitatory glutamatergic neurons
markdown:
## Protocol: Nonviral genetic engineering of human pluripotent stem cells with a two-plasmid PiggyBac architecture: Lipofectamine-mediated cotransfection of a donor plasmid and a separate transposase plasmid followed by antibiotic selection of stable integrants; apply the platform to a doxycycline-controlled NGN2-BFP iPSC line, verify BFP-positive cells, select with 0.5 micrograms/mL puromycin, and cryopreserve before neuronal differentiation; require executable reagent amounts and timing, and exclude all-in-one PiggyBac vectors, CRISPR/AAVS1 targeting, viral delivery, and imaging-only studies

### Overview

This protocol details the nonviral genetic engineering of human pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs) using a two-plasmid PiggyBac architecture. The process involves Lipofectamine-mediated cotransfection of a donor plasmid (PB-TO-hNGN2-puro-BFP) and a separate transposase plasmid (EF1α-transposase), followed by antibiotic selection with puromycin to isolate stable integrants. The platform is applied to a doxycycline-controlled NGN2-BFP iPSC line. Verification of BFP-positive cells is performed via fluorescence microscopy, and selected cells are cryopreserved prior to neuronal differentiation. This protocol strictly excludes all-in-one PiggyBac vectors, CRISPR/AAVS1 targeting, viral delivery, and imaging-only studies.

### Materials/Reagents

Essential 8 media (ThermoFisher); Growth Factor Reduced Matrigel (Corning); Accutase; ROCK inhibitor (Supplement); OptiMEM; PB-TO-hNGN2-puro-BFP plasmid; EF1α-transposase plasmid; Lipofectamine Stem; Puromycin; Knockout serum replacement; DMSO; Doxycycline.

### Equipment

10 cm culture dishes; 6-well plates; Fluorescence microscope.

### Safety & Sterility

Maintain sterile technique throughout all cell culture and transfection steps. Use appropriate personal protective equipment when handling chemicals such as DMSO and puromycin.

## Piggybac-mediated stable expression of NGN2 in iPSCs for differentiation into excitatory glutamatergic neurons

### Initial Culture

1. Culture iPSCs in a 10 cm dish coated with Growth Factor Reduced Matrigel (Corning) and feed daily with Essential 8 media (ThermoFisher). [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S01 -->

### Passage and Plating

1. Passage iPSCs with warm Accutase into Essential 8 media containing 10 micromolar (µM) ROCK inhibitor. Plate 800,000 iPSCs into one Matrigel-coated well of a 6-well plate. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T1-S01 -->

### 3 - 6 hours after plating

1. Verify that cells are healthy and attached 3–6 hours after plating. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T2-S01 -->
2. Perform transfection using Lipofectamine Stem. Prepare the transfection mix in 200 μL OptiMEM containing 0.75 μg PB-TO-hNGN2-puro-BFP plasmid, 0.37 μg EF1α-transposase plasmid, and 4 μL Lipofectamine Stem, maintaining a 2:1 ratio of donor plasmid to transposase plasmid. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T2-S02 -->

### on the next day

1. Check for transfection efficiency by identifying BFP-labeled cells on the next day using fluorescence microscopy. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T3-S01 -->

### 72:00:00 after transfection

1. 72 hours after transfection, select for transfected iPSCs by treating with 0.5 μg/mL puromycin. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T4-S01 -->

### Cryopreservation

1. Cryopreserve selected iPSCs using a freezing medium composed of 70% Essential 8 media, 20% Knockout serum replacement, 10% DMSO, and 10 µM ROCK inhibitor. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T5-S01 -->

### Post-Cryopreservation Culture

1. When cells are sufficiently confluent, passage iPSCs with Accutase into a 10 cm dish. Continue to feed iPSCs daily with Essential 8 media without ROCK inhibitor, and confirm the division of stably-expressing transfected cells by observing local clusters of BFP-fluorescent cells. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T6-S01 -->

### Confirmation of Purity

1. Confirm the purity of surviving transfected cells using fluorescence microscopy. Once the population is confirmed to be pure, withdraw puromycin from the media. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T7-S01 -->

### Differentiation

1. Proceed to culture and induction to neuronal fate using doxycycline, following the 'Protocol: iNeuron differentiation from human iPSCs'. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T8-S01 -->
